description: Defines the Drupal taxonomy term entity class, including its properties, methods, and entity type annotations.

classes.name: Term
classes.description: Represents a taxonomy term entity in Drupal, with properties and methods for managing taxonomy terms.

methods.name: postDelete
methods.description: Handles cleanup after deletion of taxonomy terms, including orphaned child terms.

methods.name: preSave
methods.description: Prepares the entity before saving, ensuring parent relationships are set.

methods.description: Defines the base fields for the taxonomy term entity.

methods.name: bundleFieldDefinitions

methods.name: getFormat

methods.name: setFormat
methods.description: Sets the format of the description.

methods.name: getName
